draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for the note — glad the first project is feeling good so far, and it was great to connect at the kickoff last week.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the natural next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week — just say the word.

Best,
Nadia
